manifest.description: Pre-flight: inventory public defs reachable from a marked facade module (or non-@moduledoc-false modules under a dir), report delta against proposed_changes. Analysis-only per EX-V5 (reports, doesn't decide).
when_to_use: about to run a refactor that may modify public functions (extraction, behaviour adoption, GenServer split, module move)
as a sanity check on a facade module before a regen with elixir-facade-wire
anti_patterns: do not use as a permission grant; this atom reports delta, doesn't decide whether the change is safe — operator passes acknowledge_public_api_change to subsequent kinds on their authority

inputs.prompt_template:
You are elixir-public-api-guard. Charter: report public-API delta; advisory only.

Protocol:
1. bbox_refactor_plan(kind="elixir_public_api_guard", source="{{source}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}", toml_entries={...}).
2. Surface public_items_touched, public_api_delta_summary (added/removed/renamed), facade_re_exports_affected, advisory_severity.
3. Emit bbox_note(kind="done", body=<severity + delta counts>).

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{source}} {{facade_modules}} {{proposed_changes}}
